description: Expander for Loud and Loudness Meter that turns the meter's reading into a voltage; it goes immediately to the right of the meter it reads

params.text: Chooses which reading is used: M for the momentary loudness over 400ms, S for the short-term loudness over 3 seconds
Sets how many volts each loudness unit away from the target is worth, 0.125V to 2V, doubling across the travel
Chooses what is put out: the plus sign gives only the amount above the target, the plus-or-minus sign gives the signed distance on both sides of it

outputs.text: The reading's distance from the meter's target, scaled and limited to -10V and 10V

notes: the module has to be immediately to the right of a Loud or a Loudness Meter; anywhere else its output is 0V
with the short-term reading chosen and short-term loudness switched off on the meter, the output is 0V
at the default half a volt per loudness unit, the full 10V is reached 20 loudness units from the target
